title: A service (S) invoice with no vehicle also lands in the Parts Sales bucket
preconds: 1. A customer has an invoice whose number starts with S but whose work order has NO vehicle (seed a ZZAUTOTEST no-vehicle service work order and invoice it, if the app allows)..
steps:
1. Expand that customer.
2. Find which asset row the S invoice sits under.
expected:
1. The no-vehicle S invoice appears under that customer's "Parts Sales" row — the bucket collects work by the ABSENCE of a vehicle, not by the invoice-number prefix.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S8-E3), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-da72171 on 8/19/2026.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - a service work order cannot be created without a vehicle on this build (creating one returns an error), so a no-vehicle service invoice cannot be produced; the absence-of-vehicle bucketing is confirmed via Part Sales
